name: Harun Bahrudin
headline: I build production interfaces for web, mobile, and desktop.
intro: Frontend engineer in Jakarta. I take designs and APIs I did not write, and ship them as products people use.

capabilities.body: Next.js and React with TypeScript. I work from a design file and an API contract I did not author, and make the result hold together across every breakpoint and every state the screen can reach.

React Native and Flutter, shipped to Android and iOS. Navigation that behaves the way the platform expects, lists that stay smooth on cheap hardware, and the loading and error states most builds forget.
Electron, for products that need a window instead of a tab. Long-running sessions, local files, and interfaces people leave open all day rather than visit for a minute.

services.intro: For teams that already have a design and an API, and need someone to turn them into something that ships.

offers.title: Web interfaces
offers.body: A design file becomes a working Next.js application. Responsive, accessible, and complete down to the empty and error states.

offers.title: Mobile apps
offers.body: React Native or Flutter, built to the platform's own conventions rather than a web layout wrapped in a shell.

offers.title: Desktop apps
offers.body: Electron builds for internal tools and operator software, where the work happens in one window over a long session.

services.howIWork: Async and in writing, in English. I am in Jakarta at UTC+7, which overlaps with European mornings and the full Asian working day. You get a link to something running early, and a short written update at the end of each week.
services.notDoing: Backend architecture, database design, and brand identity. I will build against your API and your design system, and I will tell you early when a spec has a hole in it, but I am not the person to design either one from scratch.
